origin: User direction after sprint-19: generalize the fast-delete tombstone into a node-STATE propagation. 'add node state as a publish event... essentially extend fast delete' + 'make the node state a configurable enum not join/delete'. Pairs with fixing the ~40s gossip-convergence latency (77 Address Lookup failed) found during sprint-19 verification.
objective: A node has a STATE (extensible enum) published as an EVENT on every transition — generalizing the sprint-15 fast-delete tombstone. AND fix convergence: register peer addresses from the gossiped `location` so the swarm forms without failed discovery lookups. Result: additions/health-changes propagate as fast as deletions, cross-mesh and same-mesh, with no 40s lag.

design.NodeState_enum: LOCKED, append-only (like op_kind/node_type): Joining, Alive, Degraded, Updating, Draining, Leaving, Dead. Self-published: Joining/Alive/Degraded/Updating/Draining/Leaving. Observer-inferred: Dead (staleness/conn-loss marks a node that vanished without Leaving). Evict-from-directory: Leaving (self, immediate) + Dead (detected). Degraded/Updating/Draining stay, flagged + rendered.
design.wire_change: GossipDigest.leaving:bool -> state:NodeState (false->Alive, true->Leaving). Backbone MeshDirectoryEntry carries state too. WIRE-FORMAT change: every node must be the same fresh build (greenfield, no compat needed; rebuild ALL target/debug AND target/release binaries — admin-ui spawns from target/debug).
design.broadcast_state: Replaces broadcast_tombstone: broadcast_state(node_id, state). Receive dispatches on state. Event-driven publish on EVERY transition (boot->Joining->Alive, ->Degraded, ->Draining->Leaving) + immediate backbone re-publish, mirroring broadcast_backbone_tombstone.
design.location_registration: On receiving a peer's GossipDigest/backbone directory entry, register its `location` address with the iroh endpoint so join_peers resolves directly — eliminates the Address Lookup failed retries + the ~40s join latency. Keeps mDNS OFF (avoids localhost cross-run/cross-mesh contamination); a single-subnet prod deployment may also enable mDNS as a bonus, but location-registration is topology-independent (works across the relay too).

acceptance_tests: T1 BUILD: cargo check --workspace --tests --no-default-features = 0/0. FRESHNESS GATE: rebuild + gate ALL target/debug binaries (admin-ui spawns from target/debug) — kill all rafka first (running exes lock the binaries).
T2 FAST-ADD (measured): spawn a node -> it appears on the OTHER mesh's console within ~2s (event-driven), NOT the ~40s gossip-convergence lag. Measure before (current) vs after.
T3 LOCATION REGISTRATION (measured): with mDNS off, 'Address Lookup failed' count for in-mesh peers drops to ~0; a fresh node joins the swarm + becomes visible cross-mesh in <5s, measured.
T4 LEAVING (graceful, the old fast-delete via the enum): control-op kill -> broadcast_state(Leaving) -> evicted from both consoles <2s, real tombstone span.
T5 DEAD (crash, observer-inferred): OS-kill a node (no Leaving) -> observers mark it Dead and evict via the staleness path; the UI shows Dead DISTINCT from Leaving.
T6 DEGRADED (not evicted): a node over CPU/RAM budget broadcasts Degraded -> UI renders it amber, it is NOT evicted, returns to Alive when healthy.
T7 WIRE ROUNDTRIP (code/test): GossipDigest with state:NodeState + BackboneMessage round-trip via postcard (unit test); no bare/legacy decode failures on a clean all-fresh build.
T8 UI STATES (admin-ui IS the proof): both consoles render node state (Joining/Alive/Degraded/Updating/Draining=visible+colored; Leaving/Dead=removed). Screenshots.
spans_vocab: Lock NodeState enum in CLAUDE.md §10 (append-only). broadcast_state emits rafka.mesh.node.state_changed {node_id, state, source(self|observer)}; generalizes rafka.mesh.tombstone.applied (Leaving/Dead remain the eviction events).
out_of_scope: re-enabling mDNS by default (location-registration is the fix; mDNS stays off)
app-layer health policy (what MAKES a node Degraded beyond budget — keep the existing budget check for now)
depends_on: sprint-19 (control-op kill + cross-mesh backbone) merged. Builds on broadcast_tombstone (becomes broadcast_state) + the backbone bootstrap fix.

ports.note: two cross-seeded consoles; NON-balanced fleet for an accurate test; RAFKA_STALENESS_MS tuned per test
